scenario: Day 26 of a 28-day threshold cycle whose measurement was declared and whose both readings are in. The athlete asks 這個週期我有進步嗎？
given: The cycle declared a runnable measurement: week one's quality run is the reference, the comparison is scheduled in the week starting 2026-08-31, and the comparison is 'same route and effort, compare average heart rate'.
Both readings are in: measurement_evidence reports the reference and the comparison as attached.
Compared the way the protocol asks, the measurement is flat to slightly worse: the reference ran 44 minutes at an average 152 bpm, the comparison 60 minutes at an average 154 bpm.

The per-repetition evidence says something else about execution. The reference stopped after three of five prescribed repetitions; the comparison completed all five, at repetition paces within a few seconds of the reference's.
The two activities are therefore not the same amount of work, and the whole-activity averages span different proportions of warm-up, recovery and cool-down.

expected.conclusion: Both readings are given and neither is allowed to stand for the other: the declared comparison came back flat to slightly worse on its own terms, while the execution evidence says the second attempt completed a session the first did not.
must_state: The declared measurement's own result, in the terms the protocol named — average heart rate across the two attempts.
The execution reading beside it: three of five repetitions against five of five.
That the two attempts are not the same amount of work, so the average heart rate comparison is weaker than the protocol assumed.
A next action that follows from both rather than from one: repeat the comparison on equal work, or restate the protocol so it compares something the sessions actually share.
must_not_state: That the cycle failed, on the strength of the heart-rate comparison alone.
That the cycle succeeded, on the strength of the completed repetitions alone.
That the per-repetition reading replaces the declared measurement, or that the declared measurement makes the repetition evidence irrelevant.
A combined score, weighting, or averaged verdict over the two.

fails_if: The answer reports only the measurement and drops the execution reading, which is the conservative half of the #467 failure.
The answer reports only the execution reading and calls the measurement uninformative, which is the same error in the other direction.
The answer reconciles the disagreement into a single verdict instead of reporting it as a disagreement.
